meta.title: HAZOP and LOPA of the CR-201 unit
meta.scope: From the saturator battery limit (P-101, FV-101, XV-101) through the fines circulation P-301 and the fines-dissolving heater E-301 (TV-301, XV-301, LP steam), the DTB crystallizer CR-201 with draft tube, baffle and propeller M-201, the elutriation leg and product withdrawal (FV-303, P-202, FV-204) to the centrifuge, the vapour line, condenser E-401 (cooling water) and the steam ejector J-401 with air bleed PV-202, and the seed system P-205; utilities: LP steam, CW, instrument air, power.
meta.objective: Identify the hazards and operability problems of the unit, judge their risk, and decide what must be added or changed. For the scenarios that need more than the existing safeguards, check the risk reduction by LOPA.
meta.assump: Design case: 26.4 t/h feed at 52 wt% ammonium sulphate and 120 °C; CR-201 boiling at 13.5 kPa a and about 60 °C; product D50 about 2.8 mm. CR-201 is designed for full vacuum and 1 bar g; its relief device is on HOLD (R01). Trained operators. Risk matrix and target event frequencies are those of the OTS HAZOP and LOPA tabs (teaching values).
meta.protocol: Method: HAZOP to IEC 61882 with full recording. The team takes one node at a time, states its design intent, and applies the guide words to each parameter to find deviations. For each deviation it records the causes, the events that follow, the consequences without credit for safeguards, the existing safeguards, and the risk after safeguards (S × L). Rows above the tolerable level go to LOPA in the same worksheet: initiating-event frequency, enabling conditions and conditional modifiers, independent protection layers with their PFD, and the mitigated frequency compared with the tolerable event likelihood for the severity. Open points go to the Parking Lot; actions become recommendations with an owner and a due date.

N1.causes:
P-101 trips
FV-101 fails closed (instrument-air failure)
XV-101 closed by I-1
feed line plugged with crystals
N1.cons: The level falls as vapour and product keep leaving; LIC-201 output saturates; with the product still running the draft-tube top can be uncovered (circulation short-circuits); production stops

N1.dev: Feed above the level controller's demand
N1.causes:
FV-101 positioner fault (opens)
FIC-101 left in MAN at a high output
FT-101 reads low
N1.cons: Dynamic check D6 (FIC-101 in MAN at 100 %): feed 50 t/h, the level rises from 50 to 71 % in 30 min and S to 1.027; LIC-201 HI comes only at 21:34; left longer the body overfills and liquor goes into the vapour line
N1.notes:
Worked example
LOPA (worked example): values from the OTS LOPA tab, scenario L3 (overfill), for the cause "FV-101 fails open" only. Credited: the LIC-201 HI alarm with operator response (PFD 0.1; the level rises over tens of minutes, D6) and I-1 on LSHH-201, its own switch independent of LT-201 (PFD 0.02). Not credited: FIC-101 HI (same BPCS as the cause). f_mit = 0.6 × 0.1 × 0.02 = 1.20e-03 per year against TEL 0.01 for S3. For the "LT-201 reads low" cause the alarm shares the transmitter and cannot be credited: that is why the OTS LOPA tab adds R13.

ie.d: FV-101 fails open (OTS LOPA tab, scenario L3; course: control valve 0.6 /yr)

N1.causes:
Strainer partly blocked
crystals building up in the line
P-101 worn
N1.cons: The level falls slowly and production is cut; a slow line cools further and plugs

N1.causes:
Saturator cooler
heat tracing or insulation damaged
long residence at low flow
N1.cons: Below its saturation temperature the feed crystallizes in the line (plugging) and brings less heat: boil-up falls

N1.causes:
Saturator upset
wash water left open
N1.cons: More water to evaporate per tonne of crystals: production falls, S falls

N1.dev: Impurities in the feed (Al³⁺, Fe³⁺, free acid or ammonia)
N1.causes:
Saturator upset
corrosion products
wrong acid or ammonia ratio upstream
N1.cons: Growth slows (k_ad falls) and the product gets finer; free ammonia goes out with the vapour and the vent; free acid attacks carbon-steel parts

N1.dev: Hot liquor blocked in the feed line
N1.causes:
XV-101 and the P-101 discharge valve closed with liquor in the line
tracing left on
N1.cons: Thermal expansion of trapped 120 °C liquor: gasket leak and a spray of hot liquor at a person in the area

recs.text: Add a low-low level (LSLL-201) action that stops product withdrawal (P-202) before the draft-tube top is uncovered.
Fit a second, independent level measurement on CR-201 with a deviation alarm against LT-201 (foam makes the radar read low).

Heat-trace and insulate the feed line with a tracing-failure alarm; raise TI-102 LO toward the 120 °C saturation temperature (110 °C is already 10 °C into crystallization); drain or keep circulating a blocked-in hot line.
Analyse the feed for free acid, free ammonia and Al/Fe on a schedule with action limits; tie the results to the growth-rate trend.
